directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a letter to express your thanks to your parents or any family members upon making memorable achievement. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Dear Mom and Dad,

I am writing this letter to express my heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support and love, which have been the driving force behind my recent academic success.

To begin with, your consistent encouragement has given me the confidence to face challenges head-on. Whenever I felt discouraged during my studies, your kind words and positive attitude helped me regain my motivation. For example, when I failed an important exam last semester, you told me that failure is just a stepping-stone to success.

In addition, you have provided me with a comfortable and peaceful study environment. You made sure that I had everything I needed, from books to a quiet room. This allowed me to focus on my studies without any distractions.

Furthermore, your sacrifices for my education are immeasurable. You have worked hard to ensure that I have the best educational opportunities, even if it meant making personal sacrifices.

In conclusion, I am truly grateful for everything you have done for me. I will continue to work hard and make you proud.

Love,
[Your Name]
